bead.title: Implement ordered hybrid async batch barrier
bead.description: Implement the single sequencing point for hybrid-async mutations. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs and focused tests. The ordered barrier must force-seal prior buffered writes before claim selection, ensure every claim observes all prior memory-applied claims, append ordered log batches, apply commands to memory sequentially before any response is released, and attach per-command outcome metadata. Batching must not relax visibility/order semantics or create one-command segments unnecessarily. Out of scope: SQLite checkpoint persistence.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-engine ordered -- --nocapture` passes.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog objectlog_hybrid_force_seals_before_claim_and_fences_stale_epoch -- --nocapture` passes.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-server --test server objectlog_hybrid_force_seals_before_claim_and_fences_stale_epoch -- --nocapture` passes.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
